Name: Star Shower
Components: V, M (A word spoken in a hearts confidence)
Description:
With a word breathed into the palm of your hands, a hail of showers materializes in glimmering light above your back, shooting away to bathe an area within 60-feet.

You may point to any space within reach, and a hail of shooting stairs falls down upon a 15-foot circle around that point. Any creature within reach must pass a Dexterity Saving Throw or take 3d4 force damage, taking half on a success. Any creatures who fails this saving throw has a star crash and crumble over them, causing them to glow in a bright light that covers a 30-feet sphere around them. The entire area is also covered in bright lights that cover 30-feet around itself.

When you cast this spell, you may choose to deal no damage.
At Higher Levels: When this spell is cast at a level higher than 2nd, it deals another 2d4 force damage per slot spent above 2nd level.
